documents.title: Evaluating LLMs as a Bridge Between Cyber Threats and Business Risk (page 13)
documents.snippet: % 1% 19% 32% 42% 26.4% Figure 2: Pass Rate by Category and Prompt Strategy (AI-Instrument Scoring) Averaged across all five prompt strategies, three of the four threat categories produced pass rates in a narrow band: ransomware (43.6%), business email compromise (42.8%), and zero-day/edge device exploitation (42.4%). Supply chain attack reports were markedly different, achieving only a 26.4% pass rate, more than 16 percentage points below the nearest category. This differential persisted across most individual strategies, indicating that the supply chain presents a consistent translational challenge rather than a strategy-specific anomaly.
